label: Scene Template: Compare / Old Way vs New Way
description: WHOLE-SCENE template: two worlds, one winner. The left side is the old way -- jittering type scraps at chaotic angles (some struck through); the right side is the new way -- one calm numbered column. A divider draws between them; at the flip beat the old world collapses and blurs away, the winner slides center, and the resolve headline lands. Use for before/after, manual-vs-automated, us-vs-them beats. Dark by default.

left_label.label: Old-way label, e.g. THE OLD WAY

left_lines.label: 4-8 short scraps of the mess (real pains, tools, artifacts)

headline.label: The resolve line after the flip; | breaks lines
